verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs claim Slack integration where the agent sends notifications, asks for clarification, and reports progress directly in Slack channels, plus updates statuses/comments in Jira/Linear/Clickup/Monday, which supports notification-on-completion or needing input. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated notification system (e.g., email, push, configurable alerts) beyond Slack/PM tool integrations, and no independent confirmation of reliability.
